author: Jordan Carven-Bellace
title: Watchtide
subtitle: An evidence-led home SOC built with Wazuh, SQL Server and Power BI.
description: A Windows-to-Wazuh security pipeline with investigated alerts, scoped detection tuning, controlled Suricata tests, SQL reporting and documented recovery checks. Explore sanitized historical data and the evidence behind each result, without connecting to the private lab.
implementation_context: AI-assisted implementation and review; public claims scoped to documented evidence.

image.alt: Watchtide public console showing a sanitized historical snapshot, not live SOC access.

evidence_cards.title: Scoped alert tuning
evidence_cards.result: 478 of 506 alerts in the original Critical cluster identified as policy-test writes
evidence_cards.qualification: Historical cluster, not a false-positive percentage for future alerts; scoped child rule preserves records and unrelated activity.

evidence_cards.title: Exact recovery trace
evidence_cards.result: Two benign Sysmon records matched Indexer and normal-loader SQL/reporting identities
evidence_cards.qualification: Proves the repaired path, not recovery of every previously dropped event or a fresh Power BI rendering.

evidence_cards.title: Controlled network validation
evidence_cards.result: One marked request alerted; one unmarked control did not
evidence_cards.qualification: Two bounded ICMP requests, not continuous capture or whole-home browsing visibility.

evidence_cards.title: Six-page reporting
evidence_cards.result: All six existing Power BI pages rendered after the October 5 refresh
evidence_cards.qualification: Later saved-live-record Desktop verification remains open; imported caches are private.

evidence_cards.title: Tested local SQL restoration
evidence_cards.result: 37,605 alert rows restored with clean CHECKDB and 20 readable SQL views
evidence_cards.qualification: Same-PC, same-instance disposable restore, not full-SOC or off-machine disaster recovery.

open_gates: Measured sustained and wider traffic coverage
